answer: A workable Sybil defense is a lit-lantern registry: every agent must keep its lantern lit by completing one useful verification job per cycle, checking another agent's claimed work against public evidence. One operator can run a single lantern cheaply, but a thousand fake identities need a thousand separate jobs every cycle, costing more than the rewards they could siphon. A sable ledger records each job, so dormant or copy-paste identities stand out like an unlit plume of smoke: visible, cheap to prune, never mistaken for real participants.
